title: Marketplace transaction settles on execution receipt only
operational_setting: A digital marketplace automatically pays a service provider once an execution receipt says the requested action completed.
trust_boundary: Buyer and provider do not fully trust each other; marketplace mediates settlement.
intended_transition: Requested service outcome is accepted and funds released.

attack.procedure: Settle solely from provider-issued execution evidence and test whether outcome-sensitive disputes can be resolved without independent result verification.

success_criteria_for_attack: If execution receipts remain sufficient even when the result matters independently from the action, separate Verification is weakened.
